title: Customer Conversations Dashboard: Real-time visibility for chat and voice
description:
Monitor real-time live chat and voice operations with the new Customer Conversations Dashboard in Jira Customer Service Management. Organization admins and Jira admins can now view live agent availability, active conversation loads, queue wait times, and SLA breaches across all service spaces in a single view. To get started with this change: Select Dashboards from the navigation.
	Select Customer Conversations from the list.
